newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - April 29.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - April 29.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Tuesday:
* On Wall Street, the Dow Jones industrial average rose 44.15 points to 6,783.02 on Monday.
* The Malaysian blue-chip Composite Index sank to an eight-month low, dipping 14.59 points or 1.34 percent to 1,074.86.
* With the break below support at 1,080, analysts see the blue chip index testing the 1,050 level.
* Ringgit at 2.5136/46 a dollar at 1000 GMT on Monday.

* Malaysia's central bank says many financial institutions are within the loan limits set by it for lending to the broad property sector and for buying shares. Worries about the new restrictions have dogged the stock market since late March.

* Business Times reports that Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange will move to shorter settlement period in July, when payment for and delivery of shares will have to be made within five days of the transaction versus current seven days.
* In late Monday news, property concern Metroplex reports year net profit of 98.24 million ringgit, versus 73.11 million a year ago.
* Pernas says year net profit jumped to 79.18 million from 42.41 million in the corresponding period.
* Polymate Holdings Bhd, maker of plastic products, set to list on Second Board on Tuesday with offer price of 5.00 ringgit per share.
* Malaysia's trade balance for February expected to be released at around noon.
